name: 照尘寺（暂名）
status: research_only; no scene has been built; see acceptance criteria in PLAN.md
source_of_truth: atlas-entry.json (T03) + this pack; numbers marked 推算 come from OSM/SRTM and are not survey data
real_prototype: 云南剑川沙溪兴教寺 (Xingjiao Temple, Shaxi, Jianchuan, Yunnan) and 寺登街四方街
units: metres; +y up; north is -z; origin at the centroid of Sifang Square

zones.name: 街巷（东巷）
objects: 东寨门（石基土坯墙，重建物）
zones.floor: lane level, about 2099 m (SRTM estimate), slightly lower than the square
zones.collision: lane is a deck; gate walls and shop fronts are solids; the lane is 3-4 m wide

zones.name: 广场（四方街）
objects: 四方街（约 59.7 × 22.1 m，896.6 m²，OSM 推算）
两棵古槐（南树 2004 补种）
寺门（西）与古戏台（东）相对
生活事件 3-5 个（摆货/扫地/送货/开门/收摊）
zones.floor: about 2105-2107 m (SRTM estimate); proposed 0.3 m fall to the east
zones.collision: square is a deck; the locust trunks are posts; shop fronts are solids; the stage and gate are solids with doorways

zones.name: 戏台侧边
objects: 古戏台（9.5 × 11.2 m，三层三重檐歇山，14 飞角，脊顶 12.2 m）
背面室外楼梯（后加，可看不可上）
zones.floor: stage platform about 0.1 m above the square
zones.collision: the stage is a solid; a 3-4 m standing band in front; the rear stair is visible but not climbable

zones.name: 寺院一进
objects: 寺门/门楼（10.1 × 8.3 m，两层重檐硬山，中开间通道）
第一进天井（提案 8-10 m 深）
观音楼（10.9 × 8.6 m，两层重檐悬山）
原创壁画 1-3 幅（第一进侧墙/观音楼）
zones.floor: gate threshold about 0.3 m above the square; the first court about 0.4 m
zones.collision: the gate middle bay is walkable; side walls are solids; wing buildings and Guanyin tower are solids; the middle hall and main hall are solids (out of scope)

route.climb_m: almost none; the square is nearly flat (SRTM); proposed 0.3-0.6 m steps at the gate
route.note: x east, z south (north is -z); waypoints are draft and follow the OSM building centres; the loop is 东巷→广场→戏台→一进→回广场

checkpoints.system: 广场记·五处（见 CHECKPOINTS.md）；不做集齐门槛，不评分，不做表演

optional.name: 灯·石狮油灯
optional.condition: evening; the lion-hole story is oral tradition

optional.name: 戏·排练
optional.condition: when a rehearsal is on; needs performers' consent

lighting.preset: S01 autumn soft light (late afternoon) as the base; winter clear and after-rain as separate variants; no interior preset in v1
lighting.main_light: autumn 10-11月, 16:00-17:30; diffuse sky with a soft low sun from the west/southwest; long shadows, warm-neutral, thin haze; no golden-hour orange filter
lighting.local_light: evening square lamps (the lion-lamp story is oral tradition); gate threshold lantern; no lamp at noon
lighting.fog: thin autumn haze toward Aofeng Mountain and the fields; the lane stays darker
lighting.wetness: red sandstone dry in the base preset; wet after rain; the earthen wall shows damp at its foot
